name: AddCloudAccess

parameters.help_en: The cloud service provider. Currently, only Tencent Cloud (Tencent) is supported. Note: This parameter is required. If it is not specified, the API returns a MissingParameter (400) error
parameters.help_zh:
云服务供应商。目前仅支持腾讯云（Tencent）.
注意：本参数实际为必填项，未提供时 API 返回 MissingParameter(400)
parameters.name: cloud_name

parameters.help_en: The secret ID for accessing the cloud resource set. Note: This parameter is required. If it is not specified, the API returns a MissingParameter (400) error
parameters.help_zh:
云资源集访问的密钥ID。
注意：本参数实际为必填项，未提供时 API 返回 MissingParameter(400)
parameters.name: secret_id

parameters.help_en:
The access key secret. Valid values:

If AkType is set to primary:
Tencent: The SecretAccessKey of the primary account.

If AkType is set to sub:
Tencent: The SecretAccessKey of the sub-account.

Note: This parameter is required. If it is not specified, the API returns a MissingParameter (400) error
parameters.help_zh:
AK参数Secret。取值：

1.AkType取值primary:
Tencent：主账号SecretAccessKey

2.AkType取值sub:
Tencent：子账号SecretAccessKey

注意：本参数实际为必填项，未提供时 API 返回 MissingParameter(400)
parameters.name: secret_key
